messages:
Jia: FYI — had a quick idea after yesterday's 504 burst. I think our post-incident flow could save a ton of time if we automate scribe capture + customer-impact tagging at paging time.
Omar: curious — do you mean the oncall should hit some dropdown when they ack, or automatic inference from alerts?
Jia: a mix. minimal friction: when someone acks, IncidentBot prompts a quick 'impact' picker (none/minor/major/customer-facing) + short freeform note. Also auto-capture the error rates and affected routes snapshot.
Sara: +1. right now we rely on a manual post-incident step and it's inconsistent. If we capture it earlier the postmortem triage will be easier.
IncidentBot: @Jia tagged this incident as 'acknowledged' by @Omar. Suggested next: run `/incident capture-impact` to fill structured fields.
Omar: Can IncidentBot pre-fill based on traffic anomaly windows? e.g., if 5xx rate > X it suggests 'major'?
Tess: That would be great. Even a heuristic helps reduce cognitive load. But we should keep override option. Also need to avoid false positives for transient spikes.
Nate: We also need to ensure the scribe isn't overloaded. Proposal: when incident is acknowledged, bot DM rotates to next oncall scribe and posts a lightweight template in the thread. Template:
```
- Timeline: 
- Customer impact: (none/minor/major)
- Queries to run: (e.g., error rates, traces)
- Immediate actions: 
- Followups: 
```
Jia: love the rotation idea. We should tie the scribe DM to the oncall schedule. We have a schedule API in /infra/schedule.
Sara: Another thing — add a required 'customer impact justification' field whenever 'major' is selected. That will help product and support triage.
Omar: And we should auto-create a postmortem draft in our PM tool (linked to incident id) with fields filled from the bot answers. Could be a Google Doc or a Notion page.
IncidentBot: Proposed action: create-postmortem-draft({"incident_id": "2134567890", "impact": "major", "scribe": "Nate"})
Tess: For tracking, we need an 'action item dashboard' that surfaces open remediation items across recent incidents, owner, ETA, and status. Preferably with filters by service/impact/customer.
Nate: I can mock a Grafana dashboard that pulls from our postmortem DB. Key columns: incident id, created_ts, impact, action_count, open_actions, owner, expected_eta.
Jia: Let's keep the schema simple so the bot can push rows: incident_id, impact_tag, scribe, pm_link, open_actions. Also add a boolean 'customer_notify_required'.
Omar: On automation: after incident resolves, bot should auto-schedule a postmortem meeting if impact >= major or open_actions > 0. The meeting should default to 48-72h and auto-ping stakeholders.
Sara: But allow the oncall to mark "no postmortem needed" with a reason. Also capture 'customer outreach' steps and whether support was looped in.
Tess: Security note: if incident touches PII or compliance, bot should mark private and only invite certain groups. We need a flag.
Jia: Good call. We'll add 'compliance_flag' and 'sensitive' tags to the draft.
Nate: Roadmap proposal:
1) Week 0: incident bot prompts on ack + scribe rotation (MVP)
2) Week 2: auto-create postmortem drafts + impact heuristics
3) Week 4: action-item dashboard + auto-schedule meetings
4) Week 6: customer-notify workflow + compliance gating
Omar: That timeline seems reasonable. Who can own MVP?
Nate: I can own the dashboard and the schedule integration.
Jia: I'll prototype the bot prompts + minimal DB schema. Sara will help define impact justification wording. Tess will review security controls.
Sara: I'll draft short copy for the bot prompt so it's unambiguous for oncall people.
IncidentBot: Action recorded: owners assigned {"bot_owner": "Jia", "dashboard_owner": "Nate", "security_owner": "Tess"}.
Omar: One more ask — add a short CLI for oncall to run quick post-incident queries that populate the draft. e.g., `ri incident snapshot 2134567890 --top-errors --latency`
Jia: yes — we can add helper commands to /infra-tools. They should append results to the postmortem doc.
Tess: Does anyone object to starting the MVP this sprint? If not I'll add to eng-oncall backlog and tag for prioritization.
Sara: No objections from me. :thumbsup:
Nate: I'll slot the dashboard spike for next week.
Omar: I'll clone the schedule bot code and add scribe rotation.
Jia: Great — I'll open a thin RFC in this thread with mock screenshots and the bot messages. Thanks everyone.
Tess: thanks! tagging @product and @support in the follow-up RFC once it's ready.
Jia: (reacts :rocket:)
